message:
Structural Dynamicist, Bridge Retrofit Engineer, Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead and Manager, comfort acceptance for this 1.9 Hz mode must use Human-Induced Vibration of Steel Structures, defined as Human-Induced Vibration of Steel Structures (HIVOSS), and French footbridge vibration guide, defined as French footbridge vibration guide (Setra), bands because 1.9 Hz lies inside the critical vertical walking range. In plain words resonance at walking pace forces a band verdict not a feel judgement. Retrofitted 0.67 m/s2 from the crowd build-up simulation (E45) sits inside Medium 0.5 to 1.0 m/s2 versus bare 8.28 m/s2 from the bare-acceleration calculation (E43), with 0.67 m/s2 at 0.068 times gravity a small fraction and 8.28 m/s2 at 0.844 times gravity near body weight outside everyday feel.

Bridge Retrofit Engineer, Structural Dynamicist and Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead, Maximum below 0.5 m/s2 would cost more damper and more maintenance access for little operational gain over Medium on this crowded Class III case, so Medium is the buildable trade. In plain words chasing Maximum needs larger mass or tighter tuning upkeep while Medium already removes the fall-risk shake. Class III 60 people producing 1660 N resonant force settles at 0.67 m/s2 with the twin 400 kg Tuned Mass Damper, defined as Tuned Mass Damper (TMD), versus 8.28 m/s2 bare from the crowd build-up simulation (E45), with effective 6.20 percent damping from the free-decay simulation (E17), so I accept Medium with annual tuning check from below by Below Bridge Access Vehicle, defined as Below Bridge Access Vehicle (BBAV), and keep the instrumented walk-through as after-build bench test.

Retrofit Integration and Construction Lead, I lock deck appearance as a countable topology ban separate from style: zero hardware items and zero added symbols above the walking surface, all named steel between the girders below the soffit within girder depth at midspan per the layout sketch (E55). In plain words anything counted above the deck fails appearance even when comfort passes. Above the walking surface I count added marks that are not named parts against a permitted count of zero, so the ban is not met. I am not ready, because comfort numbers hold but the zero-above-deck topology ban does not yet hold.
